note: Teton County MT has no county zoning (county planner says so). The only city zoning found is Fairfield's zoning map, published as a JPEG image (townoffairfield.com/s/Fairfield-Zoning-Map.jpeg), not a queryable service. Choteau publishes its zoning in its municipal code and a permit packet PDF, with no district polygons or GIS layer. No ArcGIS zoning layer exists for Teton County or its towns.
